### Props

| Name              | Type     | Required | Default     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app`             | `string` |          | `null`      | The owning app id, stamped on a flow created here so the app-scoped list finds it again. Omit only on the fleet-wide surface.                                                                                                                                    |
| `id`              | `string` |          | `''`        | The flow id to open. Defaults to the `id` route param, which is the normal case; pass it explicitly only when mounting outside a route. The literal `new` opens an unsaved flow.                                                                                 |
| `detailRoute`     | `string` |          | `'/flows'`  | Route path the editor lives under, used to swap the URL once a new flow gets its server-assigned id.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `run`             | `string` |          | `''`        | A run to open on arrival. Defaults to the `run` query parameter, which is where a run's own address lands: `/flow-runs/{uuid}` reads the run, finds its flow and redirects to `/flows/{id}?run={uuid}`. Pass it explicitly only when mounting outside a route.   |
| `look`            | `string` |          | `''`        | Draw this page in the `board` look (or `nextcloud`) whatever the app does. Empty follows the app's look. Manifest key `config.look`.                                                                                                                             |
| `palette`         | `string` |          | `'picker'`  | Board look: where steps come from. `picker` (default) keeps "Add a step" in the canvas toolbar; `column` draws the palette as a card beside the canvas, grouped by the app that provides each step. Manifest key `config.palette`.                               |
| `paletteFootnote` | `string` |          | `''`        | Board look: a line under the palette card. Manifest key `config.paletteFootnote`, translated with the app's catalogue.                                                                                                                                           |
| `flowDirection`   | `string` |          | `'right'`   | Board look: `down` lays the steps out top to bottom and opens them at their own size instead of zoomed to fit; `right` (default) lays them left to right. Manifest key `config.flowDirection`.                                                                   |
| `testSubject`     | `object` |          | `null`      | Board look: the records a test run can take as its subject, `{ register, schema, labelField?, label? }`. Manifest key `config.testSubject`; `label` is translated with the app's catalogue.                                                                      |
| `notice`          | `string` |          | `''`        | Board look: an info notice under the path. Manifest key `config.notice`, translated with the app's catalogue; `{name}` is the flow's name.                                                                                                                       |
| `pill`            | `string` |          | `''`        | Board look: the pill beside the flow's name ("Case type flow"). Empty shows the lifecycle for a draft or retired flow. Manifest key `config.pill`.                                                                                                               |
| `pillVariant`     | `string` |          | `'default'` | Board look: the tone of `pill` (a CnStatusBadge variant, "teal" on DqFlow). Manifest key `config.pillVariant`.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `listLabel`       | `string` |          | `''`        | Board look: the list's name at the start of the path ("Settings / Flows"). Empty reads "Flows". Manifest key `config.listLabel`.                                                                                                                                 |
| `breadcrumb`      | `array`  |          | `[]`        | Board look: the levels before the flow, each its own link (`[{ label, href? }]`, "Settings" / "Flows"); a crumb without an href links to the flow list. Labels are translated with the app's catalogue. Manifest key `config.breadcrumb`; wins over `listLabel`. |
